title: Deliver Command Priority and Severity Coordination from canonical CAP-CMD-104
goal: Deliver source-owned and independently authorized six-factor Command priority/severity coordination without confusing technical severity with effective operational priority or resolving OPEN-013 without authority.
invariants: Command owns priority/impact and Incident/Task coordination; external severity, confidence, SLA owners retain policy and source permissions.
Read-only CAP-CMD-104A is bounded Class 0; no claim of Class-2 mutation, full Inspector or production source IAM.
OPEN-013 remains open and blocks the relevant Class-2 actions, not the source-authorized read-only slice.
security_properties: No cross-tenant or environment source metadata disclosure.
Separate source permission checks; external source facts cannot confer priority mutation or authorization.

rollback.strategy: Do not accept the read-only child; keep existing Command Queue intact.

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-104 §§1–27; CAP-CMD-101 as consumer; source permission policies.
outputs: E10-CMD-104A-READONLY selected-only source-authorized factor inspection; later host production connectors and governed mutations remain separate.
acceptance_tests: Child class-0 independently tested and reviewed.
Epic stays DECOMPOSED until full canonical CAP-CMD-104 is accepted.
definition_of_ready: Canonical Command owner and parent dependencies exist.
definition_of_done: Canonical six dimensions, production source ownership/permissions, and later Class-2 actions are separately accepted.
